readerCopy.body: A current dream may expose how much an older fantasy still shapes what you expect. When Neptune opposes the South Node, the future you are imagining can come up against a story, longing, or ideal you have carried for a long time. The old picture may still be emotionally powerful even if it no longer fits the life in front of you. Name what you actually want now. You can honor the dream that got you here without making it the only acceptable ending.
